conf.description: ArcSight Connectors device-status (agent:043), avro-kafka: fields arrive pre-decoded from the Transformation Hub Avro source; compute _time/date coercion, batch-rename canonical names to ECS/arcsight.connector.*, tag event.dataset.

conf.comment: ArcSight Connectors device-status (agent:043) / avro-kafka: Transformation Hub Avro decode happens at the Kafka Source (Schema Registry), so this pipeline starts from already-decoded canonical field names -- no serde step needed here. eval computes _time from deviceReceiptTime and coerces deviceCustomDate1 to epoch ms BEFORE the batched rename (deviceReceiptTime can never target @timestamp, so it is handled entirely in eval, never renamed). The label-indirection caveat (deviceCustomNumber1/2, deviceCustomDate1, deviceCustomString1 are named by their paired *Label field, not a fixed slot) is resolved by the field table for agent:043 specifically, which fixes the slot semantics for this event class; the *Label fields themselves are left in the event unrenamed. event.severity is a direct copy of agentSeverity: no 0-10-to-platform-numeric lookup table exists in this work order, so the recommended scale conversion is a documented gap, not implemented. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: compute _time from deviceReceiptTime and normalize deviceCustomDate1 to epoch ms, before renaming
batch rename canonical ArcSight field names (mapped + partial rows) to ECS/arcsight.connector.* custom targets
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
